title: IS12:: qpa_or.c (117.4)

lines.code: Goal: The use of else-if and or operator (II)
You are admitted only if your general and IS QPAs
lines.explanation: This and the following line explain the logics of the program. It is important for a reader to understand what is going on
This constant defines general QPA threshold
This constant defines IS QPA threshold
The general QPA is read as a floating point number and assigned to variable qpa1
The IS QPA is read as a floating point number and assigned to variable qpa1

lines.code: /* make the decision using or operator (II) connecting two conditions */

lines.explanation: This complex condition will be true (i.e., 1) if at least one of the components is true -  ether qpa1 < MINQPA or qpa2 < MINISQPA or both

lines.code: printf("Your QPA is too low for BSIS\n");
lines.explanation: If the complex condition is true (1) this "then" part is executed reporting low QPA
Else part will be executed if the condition is false, in that case it means that qpa1 >= MINQPA and qpa2 >= MINISQPA

lines.code: printf("You are admitted to BSIS program!\n");
lines.explanation: In that case, the report about admission is printed
